observations.behavior: Adds a check against the GitHub Actions variable PUBLIC_IMAGE_PUSH_PAUSED to the push condition.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog operations to temporarily pause public image pushes while retaining the ability to push to private registries or skip public distribution, without changing the underlying build or release configuration.

observations.behavior: Adds the same PUBLIC_IMAGE_PUSH_PAUSED check to the Helm chart publishing step's conditional execution.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog operations to temporarily pause Helm chart publishing while retaining the ability to publish to private registries or skip public distribution, without changing the underlying build or release configuration.
